verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents tax-compliant invoices, credit notes applied to invoices, customizable payment receipts, custom fields, and automatic delivery through scheduled and recurring invoices. Sequential numbering and memos are not evidenced, and automatic delivery is only shown for invoices. missing for 10: sequential numbering evidence, memo/notes field evidence, automatic delivery of credit notes and receipts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: Create a credit note and apply it to an invoice.
Enhance the look and feel of your payment receipts with customizable templates.
Create custom fields to capture more details.
Zoho Invoice lets you schedule your invoices to be automatically sent to your customers on the date you choose.
Create recurring invoices for transactions that occur at regular intervals
